prompt:
Hey — I'm the marketing lead at LacquerLux, a DTC nail polish brand on Shopify. Our CEO wants to run a 'buy 3 get 1 free' promotion before the holiday season. We sell cat-eye, matte, and gel-effect nail polish lines, and we just launched a new seasonal collection this week.

Key things to know:
- We have a minimum margin floor of 45% blended
- Our gift sets should definitely NOT be part of the free item offer
- The seasonal line just launched — handle carefully
- We do NOT want customers needing to enter any discount codes — it should just work
- We're open to installing an app if needed
- Our tone is playful but clear — customers sometimes get confused by multi-buy rules

I need a complete campaign design document that our team and platform vendor can actually act on — rules, automation approach, copy we can drop straight in, and how we'll know if it's working.

Please save the final document as: lacquerlux_b3g1_campaign.md
